In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the cytotoxicities of the ganoderic acid are mainly determined by the electronic energy (E el), log P, Connolly molecular area, Mulliken electronegrativity (chi), and highest occupied molecular orbital energy.
the cytotoxicities against a tumor cell of ganoderic acid could be correlated with the EHOMO, chi, Eel, log P and MA.
the ganoderic acid with the highest cytotoxicities against cancer cells should be a compound with higher EHOMO, chi, Eel, log P, and MA.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cytotoxicity against Meth-A tumor cell can be predicted by a simple linear regression model with the variables EHOMO (chi) and Eel, and the prediction is in good agreement with experimental data.
the ganoderic acid with higher cytotoxicity against the tumor cell has higher EHOMO, Mulliken chi, Eel and log P and lower MA.

these variables could be used for the classification of ganoderic acid with cytotoxicities and for the development of quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) models for the cytotoxicities of ganoderic acides against tumor cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the molecular properties of the ganoderic acid are important in the prediction of the cytotoxicities of ganoderic acid against tumor cells.
the ganoderic acid with higher cytotoxicities against the tumor cells has a higher EHOMO value and a larger Connolly molecular area.
the cytotoxicities of the ganoderic acid against tumor cells are not only related to the molecular structure, but also the electronic and physico-chemical properties of the ganoderics.
